name: KLCC
summary: Kuala Lumpur City Centre: the Petronas Twin Towers, Suria KLCC, KLCC Park, the KL Convention Centre and Ombak KLCC, around KLCC LRT (KJ10, Kelana Jaya Line) and Persiaran KLCC MRT (PY21, Putrajaya Line).
notes: Study area: 1.2 km x 1.2 km centred between the Petronas Twin Towers and Persiaran KLCC MRT, so that the towers, Suria KLCC, the Convention Centre, KLCC Park, Ombak KLCC and both stations sit inside with a margin (positions from OpenStreetMap, 2026-10-12). Ampang Park (KJ9 / PY20) and Conlay (PY22) lie at the edges.
